summary: Scoped backend+frontend verification completed for master client package scripts. Ran new pytest regression suite (16 tests): 15 passed, 1 failed. External /api/health returned 200, and frontend login screen loads on public URL.

critical.issue: NIK 16-digit masking is not applied in generated markdown review (PERTANYAAN_KLIEN.md). Repro: pass temuan message containing 16-digit NIK to write_questions(); output keeps raw NIK instead of [NIK KTP disamarkan].

issues: Core interactive elements do not expose stable data-testid attributes for robust automated testing.

action_items: Apply redact() to evidence messages when writing PERTANYAAN_KLIEN.md in write_questions().
Add data-testid attributes to login inputs and submit button for maintainable UI test automation.
Re-run /app/tests/test_master_client_package.py after redaction fix; expected full pass 16/16.
critical_code_review_comments: Privacy guard is inconsistent: write_answers() redacts strings cell-by-cell, but write_questions() writes evidence text directly without explicit redact().
import_master_template.py remains very large (>800 lines); split by sheet handlers would reduce regression risk and improve targeted testing.
Path safety, dry-run read-only behavior, idempotency checks, and public destination rejection behavior are functioning as intended in this run.
test_credentials: File /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but is effectively empty (no credentials listed). No auth flow was executed in this scoped run.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Tests used local temp files/fixtures and dry-run only behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh regression suite added at /app/tests/test_master_client_package.py covering package artifacts, path guards, duplicate catalog analysis, BOM conversion guard, read-only DB wrappers, dry-run non-mutation check, and external health check. Current blocker is a single privacy redaction failure in markdown question output.
rca of the issue: Root cause: markdown generator write_questions() outputs item['pesan'] directly from temuan evidence without forcing redact(). If upstream input has not already been sanitized, 16-digit NIK values leak into PERTANYAAN_KLIEN.md. Mitigation: apply redact(item['pesan']) at write time and keep existing redact() in workbook writer for defense-in-depth.
